column1: # SFA1 FULL-COVERAGE map -- arcade command -> Saturn SFA1 CD-DA arranged
# track, for the non-stage cues. STATUS: EAR-CONFIRMED rev 4
# -- all pairs ear-approved; the credit rolls are SWAPPED vs the naive
# alignment (arcade Credit Roll 1 = Saturn Staff Roll B track tr50).
# SOURCES.  Audio: the 1996 Saturn port's arranged CD-DA (the listening gate
# rejected the Anthology in-game bank; the Anthology ARRANGE bank the
# shipped stages use is the SAME RECORDING as the Saturn arranged stages,
# r=+0.999 -- one master family).  Command grounding: every row matched by
# rate-corrected waveform NCC against the reference CPS2 gamerip (which is
# 48 kHz audio mislabelled 44.1 kHz -- stretch factor 48000/44100=1.0885;
# uncorrected it matches NOTHING, measured r 0.06 on known-identical Ryu).
# Board renders via service-mode injection (MAME sfa; attract-mode
# injection is swamped by the 68K's own latch writes).  The board's own
# SOUND & VOICE test confirms code == raw latch command.
# STRUCTURE.  Endings are TWELVE consecutive commands 0x15-0x20 in CPS2
# character order, then CREDIT ROLL 1 at 0x21; Dan (the add-on character)
# has his ending OUTSIDE the block at 0x33, mirroring his stage at 0x32.
# 0x25 is a DUPLICATE command for Sodom's ending (audio == 0x19, r=0.989).
# Credit Roll 1/2 (arcade) == Staff Roll A/B (Saturn) ear-adjudicated.
# Saturn disc layout: tr02-09 utilities, tr10-22 "(arcade)" stage renders
# arranged endings (arrange char order), tr49/50 staff rolls.
